data.name: LAST WITCH
data.detailed_description:
■ Only One Shall Return Alive.

Once every ten years, an inescapable "Witch Mark" suddenly manifests on ten chosen witches, pulling them toward a forbidden, isolated island.

The only way to return to normal life is to defeat all other rivals and become the **last survivor**.

In an island steeped in paranoia and dark intrigue, a fateful **Battle royale Simulation** begins.

■ Game Systems

  • 【Battle royale Simulation: Every Choice Counts】

The game advances in two phases each day: **Day** and **Night**.

Choose one of the 10 witches and fight for survival against 9 cunning CPU rivals.

Move, explore, rest, or attack—with limited actions each phase, manage your resources, adapt to enemy movements, and make the optimal choice to survive.

  • 【The Closing Perimeter: Curse Erosion System】

The 6x6 island is gradually consumed by a deadly curse over time.

Safe areas shrink with every passing phase, eventually forcing the surviving witches into an unavoidable final showdown in the remaining territory.

  • 【50 Weapons × 25 Items × Unique Character Skills】

From kitchen knives and massive scythes to ancient grimoires, discover a vast array of diverse equipment.

Combine weapons and items with each character's unique Special (SP) skills to adapt your build and tactics to the evolving battlefield.

■ 10 Witches & Their Lingering Stories

  • 【Rich Story Episodes for Every Character】

A girl fighting to protect her orphanage, an avenger wielding her blade for her fallen sister, a mage defying her own curse...

Delve into the rich narrative of each witch through dedicated **Prequel**, **First Night**, and **Epilogue (Survival Ending)** episodes.

  • 【Death Records: Memories of the Fallen】

The final moments of defeated witches are quietly etched into unique Death Records tailored to each weapon.

With randomized spawns, unpredictable AI behaviors, and shifting safe zones, experience a highly replayable dark fantasy where every run weaves a distinct, bittersweet tragedy.

■ Key Features

  • Single-player Battle royale Simulation

  • Dynamic 6x6 grid map with an ever-shrinking safe zone**

  • Deep tactical freedom with 50 weapons, 25 items, and 10 unique character skills**

  • Rich story episodes for all 10 characters (Prequel, First Night, Epilogue)**

  • Unique Death Records capturing the last moments of fallen witches**

  • Atmospheric, bittersweet dark fantasy art and world-building**

data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or Vulkan compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 minimum resolution

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:
This game features dark fantasy themes and battle royale elements between characters. 
The story, in-game events, and combat logs include text-based depictions of character deaths, casualties, and mild violence/blood references. 
Please note that these depictions are presented entirely through text and narrative descriptions; there are no explicit visual gore, physical dismemberment graphics, or sexual content in the game.
